title: Cannot believe this sub exists…
content: My common recurring Mall dream has been happening my entire life. The mall is empty, sometimes I’m shopping, sometimes I’m stealing. It sometimes is a warm safe place but I’m always trying to leave. Each time I walk into a shoe store and walk to the back of the shop. Behind the shoe store is a hookah lounge. Finally I emerge outside into a parking garage. I flee the garage and trek a few hundred yards into the desert. Every time when I turn around, it’s the strangest thing. The mall is gone as well as the parking structure. All that exists is a dome/round mud hut with blankets draped across the top. No idea what this means but the phenomenon is not lost on me. Thoughts?
